data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 depends on SRC_005 because the piecewise-linear cost-function analogy (cumulative resource consumption governed by unit width, with transitions at structural boundaries) supplies the explanatory causal mechanism that justifies why the digit-budget partition into 9, 180, and 603 is the correct decomposition. It is refuted if SRC_004's partition can be fully motivated by the base-10 positional numeral system alone, without any recourse to the generalized step-function or resource-consumption framework described in SRC_005's analogy.
